How it works

The CSS Extractor tool:

  • Fetches the HTML from the specified URL
  • Parses all <style> tags and external CSS files
  • Extracts and combines all CSS rules
  • Provides statistics about the extracted styles
  • Allows you to copy or download the extracted CSS

Note: Due to CORS restrictions, this tool works best with websites that allow cross-origin requests. For production use, consider using a proxy server.
